classification_rules: Include sources.json with sources[] as original primary catalogs, regardless of entry-level unread status. Exclude every inputs/ snapshot copy.
Keep ROOT_SOURCE_REVIEW*.json entries as separate reviewer observations; never overwrite author reading status.
Inventory all other JSON but exclude artifact hashes, test results, specifications and repository baseline metadata from bibliographic counts.
Expand explicit primary_documents[] and paired_file as additional primary document occurrences. Keep PDF/permalink/identity/auxiliary URLs in a separate occurrence index.
Exclude access_failures/excluded_candidates from adopted source entry count; retain them as discovery/access audit.
Exact URL equality uses the literal stored URL, including fragments; no redirects, case folding, query stripping, version guessing or network fetch.
